The dataset has no counterfactual outcomes, so I estimated the ATC. I fitted an outcome regression (OLS on all 25 covariates) on the treated units only. I then used it to predict what the control units' outcomes would have been under treatment. The ATC is the mean of those predictions minus the controls' observed outcomes.

That gives about 4.24. Two other regression-based estimates came out close: 4.18 from a single regression with a treatment indicator, and 4.14 from the average effect on the treated.

ANSWER: 4.24
